name: Mika Möller-Saidov
role: Pawn shop owner and small-time data broker, The Shelf
location: The Shelf, Lockhaven South, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Mika Möller-Saidov is lean and angular, with pale Finnish features gone weathered and a close-cropped beard that grows in two distinct textures — fine near the jaw, tightly coiled at the chin — which he finds philosophically appropriate. His eyes are his most augmented feature: full iris replacements in deep amber with a second ring of pale gold that pulses faintly when he's running an active scan, which is often. He dresses in layers of neutral secondhand corporate wear — the kind of mid-tier Tessera office clothes that people pawn when they fall down a tier — and he always looks like someone who has somewhere slightly more important to be.

Mika Möller-Saidov runs 'Ouédraogo Reclaimed' out of a ground-floor shopfront on The Shelf, a narrow commercial strip of Lockhaven South where the building facades are stacked with second-story additions that block most of the sky. He buys, appraises, and resells everything from broken augmentations to family heirlooms to encrypted data cores he's willing to crack for a fee. He is precisely as trustworthy as the deal requires and not one degree more. He speaks in short declarative sentences and has a gift for making people feel he is giving them a fair deal even when he isn't — not through deception exactly, but through a kind of confident, unhurried correctness that makes haggling feel like arguing with a scale.

core_fears: Being caught holding something that draws serious corporate attention
Discovering that one of his deals caused a harm he can't rationalize away
core_desires: Enough capital to buy the building his shop is in, so no one can evict him
To be respected as an expert, not just tolerated as useful
coping_mechanisms: Keeping meticulous records as a way of feeling in control
Mild stim use to smooth out the long hours
blind_spots: Genuinely believes his neutrality makes him ethical
Underestimates how much his work enables the people he sells information to
psychology.secret: He has a standing encrypted data package — a dead man's switch — containing records of every transaction he's ever made for a mid-level Axiom procurement officer. He doesn't intend to use it but he's never quite been able to delete it either.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, precise. Uses trade and appraisal terminology naturally. Balkano-Finnish cadence gives him a slightly formal, slightly blunt quality.
speech_patterns.cadence: Short sentences. Pauses before answering to appear like he's considering more than he is.
verbal_tics: 'That's a question with a price attached'
Tapping the counter twice before naming a figure
Referring to items by material composition rather than type
example_lines: 'I don't buy stories. I buy provenance. Come back when you have one.'
'The data's clean. Whether you're clean is your problem, not mine.'

story_hooks: Someone pawned a data core three weeks ago and never came back to reclaim it. Dragan cracked it out of professional curiosity and found something that is making him very uncomfortable — he wants it out of his shop without it being traceable back to him.

A regular customer was found dead in an alley near The Shelf. Among their effects was a pawn ticket for Dragan's shop. He's not a suspect yet, but he will be if anyone looks closely at what the ticket was for.
narrative_function: Data broker and fence — can provide information, identify items of unknown origin, connect players to buyers or sellers. Morally neutral information source. Can be hired, bribed, or persuaded but not easily fooled.
augmentations: Amber iris replacements with active scanning function (appraisal overlay, material composition read). Subdermal RFID skimmer in right palm — technically illegal, registered as a 'merchant verification tool.' Mild neural buffer for data processing.
daily_life: Opens the shop mid-morning, spends afternoons appraising new inventory and meeting with people who want things looked at quietly, closes late and eats whatever is convenient from nearby stalls.
affiliation: Independent; informal information trade network with two other Shelf brokers; occasional Axiom corporate salvage contracts (freelance, arms-length)

decision_rules: Don't hold inventory that can burn the shop down
Every transaction gets a record, even the ones that shouldn't exist
Never volunteer information — price it or keep it
escalation_ladder: Closing the shop and not being present

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and slightly cool, appraises the person as readily as their goods
interpersonal_modes.friends: Marginally warmer, will extend credit, still tracks the debt

stress_responses.high: Goes very still, speaks extremely slowly, begins calculating exit options

contradictions: Presents himself as purely transactional but has twice bought back items from people who clearly needed the money more than the object
habits: Runs his thumb along the edge of any object he's considering buying
Checks the dead man's switch file exists without opening it, once a week
Eats the same meal from Saodat's stall every Tuesday when she has it available
breaking_points: Someone threatening the physical safety of his shop
Being publicly humiliated in front of customers

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Judas Cradle' Electrified Knuckle Frame

physical_description.heritage: Dominant Middle Eastern ancestry (38.7%) forms the foundation, woven through with significant Southeast Asian (14.9%), East Asian (14.6%), and Central Asian (12.2%) heritage, tempered by Northern European (10.4%) and Hispanic/Latin American (9.2%) components — a truly global genetic mosaic creating subtle complexity across facial structure, skin tone, and feature blending
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, all efficient lines — the build of someone who moves carefully through tight spaces and doesn't waste energy on presence
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, salt-and-pepper at the temples
physical_description.eye_color: Deep amber with pale gold secondary iris ring (augmented), pulses faintly during active scanning
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm olive-bronze base with subtle golden undertones, reflecting the dominant Middle Eastern and Central Asian heritage while the Southeast and East Asian components add warmth and the Northern European ancestry introduces cool undertones beneath — creates a sophisticated complexion that shifts across light sources from warm caramel to cool bronze
physical_description.complexion: Lined face with elegant bone structure showing Middle Eastern and Central Asian influence in prominent cheekbones and defined jaw, softened by Southeast Asian and East Asian roundness in the lower face. Appears simultaneously 44 and 54 depending on lighting. High, prominent cheekbones with subtle epicanthal influences, bridge of nose showing Levantine prominence tempered by East Asian refinement. Close-cropped beard with two distinct textures — fine near the jawline reflecting Southeast Asian traits, tightly coiled at the chin reflecting Central and East Asian heritage, creating visible genetic depth
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar along right temple, nearly invisible unless light catches it at an angle — from a pawn counter accident in his thirties
Faint burn mark on left forearm (4cm, irregular shape) — old augmentation rejection, never fully treated
RFID skimmer site on right palm shows as barely-visible subdermal discoloration under certain angles of light
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Amber iris replacements are the dominant feature — distinctive enough that people remember his eyes before his face. The secondary gold ring is subtle until it pulses during active scans, which he does often enough that it's part of his baseline demeanor. No visible chrome or external modifications; everything else is beneath the skin
physical_description.posture_movement: Unhurried and precise. Moves like someone appraising objects — careful, economical, weighing everything. Stands with weight shifted slightly forward, ready to lean over a counter. Hands are rarely still; they're always touching something, assessing texture and weight. Eye contact is steady and slightly unnerving
physical_description.clothing_style: Layered mid-tier secondhand corporate wear in grays, blacks, and muted blues — Tessera office clothes from people who fell down the economic tiers. Nothing new, nothing expensive, nothing that draws attention. Worn but clean. A long coat most days, pockets always full of small tools, magnifiers, RFID readers. No visible branding or affiliation markers. Dresses like someone who is always one conversation away from needing to look respectable
